many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

import numpy as np
from collections import Counter, defaultdict
def comps_of(a,bg):
    seen=set(); res=[]; H,W=a.shape
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if (r,c) in seen or a[r,c]==bg: continue
            col=a[r,c]; stack=[(r,c)]; cells=[]
            while stack:
                y,x=stack.pop()
                if (y,x) in seen: continue
                seen.add((y,x)); cells.append((y,x))
                for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    ny,nx=y+dy,x+dx
                    if 0<=ny<H and 0<=nx<W and a[ny,nx]==col and (ny,nx) not in seen: stack.append((ny,nx))
            res.append((col,cells))
    return res

import numpy as np
from collections import Counter

def comps_of(a,bg):
    H,W=a.shape; seen=set(); res=[]
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if (r,c) in seen or a[r,c]==bg: continue
            stack=[(r,c)]; cells=[]
            while stack:
                y,x=stack.pop()
                if (y,x) in seen: continue
                seen.add((y,x)); cells.append((y,x))
                for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    ny,nx=y+dy,x+dx
                    if 0<=ny<H and 0<=nx<W and a[ny,nx]==a[r,c] and (ny,nx) not in seen: stack.append((ny,nx))
            res.append((int(a[r,c]),cells))
    return res

def man(p,q): return abs(p[0]-q[0])+abs(p[1]-q[1])

def f2(I):
    bg=I[0][0]; H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    objs=[(c,set(cs)) for c,cs in comps4(I,bg) if len(cs)>1]
    singles=[cc for cc,(y,x) in [(cc,c[0]) for cc,c in comps4(I,bg) if len(c)==1]]
    placed={}
    OCC=set()
    res=[[bg]*W for _ in range(H)]
    for idx,(c,orig) in enumerate(sorted(objs,key=lambda p:-len(p[1]))):
        tr=norm(orig); hh=max(a for a,_ in tr)+1; ww=max(b for _,b in tr)+1
        oy=min(y for y,_ in orig); ox=min(x for _,x in orig)
        best=None
        for dy in range(-hh,H):
            for dx in range(-ww,W):
                cells={(dy+a,dx+b) for a,b in tr}
                if not all(0<=y<H and 0<=x<W for y,x in cells): continue
                cost=(max(abs(dy-oy),abs(dx-ox)) + sum((1 if (r,c) in OCC else 0) for r,c in cells))*10

def slide(I, order='big'):
    bg=I[0][0]; H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    objs=[(c,set(cs)) for c,cs in comps(I,bg) if len(cs)>1]
    objs.sort(key=lambda p: -len(p[1]))
    OCC=set(); res=[[bg]*W for _ in range(H)]
    for c,orig in objs:
        tr=norm(orig); hh=max(a for a,_ in tr)+1; ww=max(b for _,b in tr)+1
        oy=min(y for y,_ in orig); ox=min(x for _,x in orig)
        moved=True
        while moved:
            moved=False
            for ndy,ndx in ((1,0),(0,-1)):  # down and left
                new_oy=oy+ndy; new_ox=ox+ndx
                cells={(new_oy+a,new_ox+b) for a,b in tr}
                if all(0<=r<H and 0<=k<W for r,k in cells) and not (cells&OCC):
                    OCC|=cells
                    for y,x in cells: res[y][x]=c
                    break
        else:
            # fallback: just place at original position
            for y,x in orig: res[y][x]=c
    return res

            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in rr] for rr in rows]
